functions.name: sortThreeByDepth
functions.notes: Three-slot descending-depth exchange network over entities; depth is f32 at manager(entity+100)+200+16, zero when the manager is absent; returns exchange count.

validation.comparison: Depth pairs, all permutations, NaN signs/payloads, manager-absence masks, null slots, exchange counts and signed/zero/infinite branch permutations compare return, all slot pointers via full memory and stack pointer.
limitations: manager+200 == 0 is dereferenced as the original does; out-of-bounds pointers are not exercised.
Ledger: 244 server bodies recovered and 490 remain machine code.
